decisions.documents_due: Quality Report, Maintenance Log, Shipment Plan

commitments.detail: Resolve printer downtime and ensure serialized labels are available.
Verify segregation of untraceable blanks and prepare for disposal.
Coordinate pickup at 14:00 for palletized shipment.
Ensure all labels are correctly serialized.
Perform scan verification of all pallets before pickup.
Review and approve disposition plan for revision C.
Identify and fix the labeling printer issue causing downtime.
Prepare and execute the shipment plan for the approved disposition.
Ensure all serialized labels and scan verifications meet regulatory standards.
Reissue serialized labels for revision C.
Perform scan verification of all labeled parts.
